title: Source code for condition-dependent dynamic voltage–state-of-charge CALCE profiles
description: Source-aligned CALCE nominal-concordant cycle reconstruction, cell-clustered SoC-band inference, unified weighted-isotonic LUT validation (LOCO, rate and temperature hold-outs), fixed-prediction support analysis and five-representation comparison. Historical July 2026 source preserved in legacy. Additional October 2026 supplementary analyses: CR2/Satterthwaite small-cluster sensitivity, seven-coefficient nodewise ridge benchmark with cell-level inner cross-validation and log-rate/reciprocal-temperature interpolation-axis controls, and 13 held-out LUT compression representations. Source integrity, input requirements, and rerun limits are documented in the repository.
